title: Frankenstein authorship
text: Mary Shelley wrote the novel Frankenstein. The first edition appeared anonymously in 1818.

title: Capital of Australia
text: Canberra is the capital of Australia. Sydney is a major Australian city but is not the national capital.

title: First crewed Moon landing
text: The first crewed Moon landing occurred on July 20, 1969, during the Apollo 11 mission. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed on the lunar surface while Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit.

title: Element with atomic number 79
text: Gold is the chemical element with atomic number 79 and the symbol Au.

title: Sistine Chapel ceiling
text: Michelangelo painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel between 1508 and 1512.

title: Semantic entropy for language models
text: Semantic entropy measures disagreement between the meanings of sampled answers. Answers with equivalent meanings form clusters. Discrete semantic entropy uses the frequencies of those clusters. A low value does not guarantee that an answer is true, because samples may consistently repeat a wrong answer.

title: ReDeEP hallucination detection
text: ReDeEP studies external context use and parametric knowledge in retrieval-augmented generation. Its External Context Score uses attention and hidden states. Its Parametric Knowledge Score uses Jensen-Shannon divergence between vocabulary distributions before and after a feed-forward layer. AARF changes the contributions of selected attention heads and feed-forward layers.

title: Rowen adaptive retrieval
text: Rowen uses consistency across responses from different languages or models to estimate uncertainty. It retrieves external information when uncertainty is high to help revise an answer.
